task_description: Add a batch e-Sign (all-or-nothing) feature to the existing SPFx solution for the Finance library (/sites/DMS/Finance). A new COMMAND_BATCH command lets a requestor initiate signatures on >=2 PDFs or a folder at once; the initiate page configures approvers+placeholders per-document and creates one Approvals Process item per document sharing a BatchId with BatchMode=AllOrNothing; on the approval form, rejecting one document cancels its still-Processing batch siblings (leaving Approved ones alone). The single-document flow and COMMAND_1/2/3 stay behavior-identical. Columns BatchId/BatchMode are created manually by the owner; code is tolerant of missing columns. No email code and no Power Automate flow are built here (the existing item-created flow sends per-document emails).
